US Judge Seeks Adani's Knowledge on Agreement to Drop Criminal Case

A US judge has requested Gautam Adani to disclose if he has knowledge of an agreement concerning the dropping of a criminal case. The judge has set a deadline of July 15 for Adani's response. This development stems from a case being heard in the United States.
